name: @microservices/app
//name: The Configured_Scope followed by `/` and the last path segment of the Entry_Root (R1.10). No `main` and no `types` on purpose: nothing imports this package by name, and a container invokes it by path at <Entry_Root>/dist/index.js (R1.12).
//dependencies: The scoped `overseer` and `contracts` packages only. NO Microservice_Package is declared — the Selected_Microservices are Selector-dependent, and the dependency resolver rejects a manifest naming a peer microservice with its `[deps:peer]` diagnostic, from which this package gets no exemption (R1.11). The Build_Sequence supplies the microservice prerequisites synthetically instead.
//scripts: `build` and `typecheck` each perform a Registry_Generation_Step before invoking the compiler, so both succeed in this directory on a clone that has never generated a registry, provided the Build_System itself is compiled (R5.4). The shim reports that one proviso itself (R5.9).
